label: Every caused moved mover of another is moved in some respect relevant to that moving
paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the scope bridge b3573a61-ec8b-5aba-8b5f-f1d03611e7f6 restricted to caused movers. If y, whose being some other thing causes (CAUSE_2), moves x (distinct from y) in respect r and is being moved (MOTION_1) in some respect, then it is being moved in some respect relevant to that moving. Derived from 631e014f-685d-434c-86b7-4a683a507b4d, d791628f-72c6-572e-ad1e-03f4f22ba646, 0628359b-4a71-5c67-a84b-0fd80104aceb and 7bf380c6-fcdd-4b14-bae5-d5a5acdebd5c (registered, zero axioms); with the premise that whatever is moved has its being caused by another it gives b3573a61 (registered, zero axioms). It has a kept counterexample class on the lending (instrumental) reading of relevance (retained-state movers, docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md, section 3), which falsifies 631e014f under POTENCY_1 for steady exercise.
